Ønskeskyen er din digitale ønskeliste, hvor du kan oprette og gemme alle dine ønsker ét sted. Hent Ønskeskyens app og opret en profil og tilføj ønsker, som du nemt kan dele med alle dine venner. App’en gør det let for dine venner og familie at reservere og købe dine ønsker.

Det har aldrig været nemmere at styre alle dine ønskelister.

Du kan oprette ønsker til dine ønskelister fra alle webshops i hele verdenen - Der er ingen begrænsninger.

Brug også app’en til at holde styr på de ting, som du skal huske at købe til dig selv.
Det har aldrig været nemmere at dele en ønskeliste end med Ønskeskyens app. Del ønskelister med dine venner der har app’en, del via SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, e-mail eller en af dine andre favorit medier.

En af de helt store fordele ved at bruge app’en er, at du slipper for at få dobbeltgaver til fødselsdag, jul, konfirmation, bryllup, osv. Dine gæster kan følge med i, hvad der bliver reserveret af de andre gæster - uden at du selvfølgelig selv kan se det.
Du kan både bruge Ønskeskyens app eller du kan bruge Ønskeskyen.dk på din computer. Så du altid har din ønskeliste lige ved hånden.

Super nem at bruge:
Falder du over noget, som du ønsker dig, kan du gemme det på to måder: 1) Hvis det er på et website, kan du gemme direkte med et enkelt klik på ønskeknappen i din dele-menu på din iPhone eller iPad. 2) Hvis det er på et website, kan du kopiere linket til dit gaveønske og derefter gå til app’en og tryk “opret ønske automatisk”, indsæt linket og app’en klarer resten :) 3) Hvis du er i en fysisk butik eller finder produktet et andet sted, tager du et billede af produktet og opretter selv ønsket i app’en.

Vi anbefaler, at du bruger en af de to automatiske metoder til at oprette dine ønsker, da det gør det super nemt for dine venner at finde og købe præcis det, som du ønsker dig.
Alle dine ønsker havner samme sted og er tilgængelige, uanset om du bruger app’en på din iPhone, iPad eller logger ind på vores hjemmeside.

Fordele ved at bruge Ønskeskyens digitale univers:
- Opret nemt alle slags ønsker fra alle webshops
- Du kan gemme ønsker online med kun ét klik på ønskeknappen
- Du kan tage et billede og oprette ønsker, hvis du falder over noget i en fysisk butik

Your perfect companion: the Miele app gives you mobile control of your Miele domestic appliances and lets you keep track of everything – whether you are traveling or at home.

Miele app highlights:

• Mobile control of domestic appliances: operate your domestic appliances conveniently via the app. 
• Request the appliance status: can I add more laundry? How long does the program have left to run? With the app, you can keep an eye on your appliances at all times.
• FoodView: keep track of the cooking process in your oven at all times. The camera inside the oven compartment sends images to your smartphone – no matter where you are
• CookAssist: perfect roasting results with TempControl cooktops thanks to the step-by-step instructions in the Miele app.
• Recipes: find inspiration for cooking and baking with delicious recipes and how-to videos.

Download the Miele app now and discover the Smart Home functions.

MobileControl – keep an eye on everything
With MobileControl, you can control all network-enabled Miele domestic appliances quickly and conveniently using your smartphone or tablet. This means you can access your washing machine, dishwasher, or oven at any time and select the program, the start pre-selection or other options, for example.

FoodView – how are things looking in the oven?
A camera integrated into the ceiling of the oven shows you what your food looks like via your smartphone or tablet. If you need to, you can adjust the function settings on your networked oven via your mobile device.

CookAssist – the secret to perfect roasting results
Miele CookAssist not only helps you to cook the perfect steak, it is also available for a wide range of other dishes. Thanks to the step-by-step instructions in the Miele app, temperatures and cooking durations are automatically transferred to the TempControl cooktop. All you need to do is confirm the settings.

Food Service – order conveniently online
So that you can cook the desired recipe as soon as possible without any great effort, simply order the food you need online directly via a link within the app. To do this, select the recipe you want to cook and a link directs you to online retailers. 

CareAssistant – fresh and crease-free for longer
Are you out and about and not able to take your laundry out of the machine right away? Don’t worry, your CareAssistant function ensures that it remains fresh for a long time. You can use the app to extend the Anti-crease phase by 30 minutes up to a maximum of three times.

AutoStart – programmed starting via the app
With the AutoStart function, your dishwasher can be programmed via the app to always begin washing automatically at preset times. Thanks to AutoDos and PowerDisk there is always sufficient detergent available so that the appliance can get to work autonomously.

ShopConnect – order cleaning products quickly and easily via the app
With ShopConnect, you can conveniently reorder Miele consumer goods and accessories from a mobile device. If your stocks of Miele cleaning products or coffee are running low, you will receive a Push notification. You can then order supplies from the app in just a few clicks.

Download the Miele app now and enjoy the full Miele experience. 

Demonstration mode – try out the Miele app even without any Miele domestic appliances
The demonstration mode in the Miele app provides a first impression of the range of possibilities for this app even if you do not yet have any network-enabled Miele domestic appliances.
